title: Exploratory 50-candidate U.S. discovery pilot
definition: Product judgment + direct building + AI enables building. Qualifications first. Genuine engineering-background blends remain distinct; engineering or solutions work alone is insufficient.

method.AN: First 15 distinct openings from most-recent results for product with United States location on AI Native Builder. Three pages (36 cards) inspected to observe additional candidates and duplication; only the first 15 distinct openings enter the 50-row screen.
method.HC: First 15 non-overlapping openings from the public U.S. ai-product-builder relevance page, through Amperity. WEX also appeared here and was already counted in AN. This is a keyword-page comparison, not Talent Agent.
method.WEB: 20 selected candidates from independent responsibility/tool/title searches and previously surfaced employer examples. Several known examples retained. This is not an all-new, randomized or source-blinded holdout.
method.verification: Published public ATS feed or employer detail page with job and application. For dynamic pages use browser/web fallback. Absence from a feed, an HTTP failure, and employer-declared closure are separate statuses.
method.comparison_limits: Unequal queries, sort orders and sampling; assessment is subjective, partly calibrated on reused examples. Source yield here is descriptive, not overall precision/recall or a ranking of services. Source is initial sample lane, not exclusivity.
method.effort: Public requests plus manual reading and browser fallbacks. Collection fetch script elapsed seconds is recorded below; human-equivalent review time and cost per relevant role were not reliably timed.
method.storage: Metadata, authored summaries and short evidence passages only. No credentials or full job descriptions.

duplicate_observations: WEX R22767 surfaced through two career-site domains on AN, and on HC.
SharkNinja finance director surfaced through a branded careers page and Greenhouse.
Sony principal FDE surfaced through both branded and Workday URLs on AN page three; these cards are outside the 15-row AN screen.

targeted_AN_overlap_checks.query_scope: United States location retained; employer-name queries, exact outbound posting checked where visible. These checks do not establish inventory-wide absence.
inconclusive: Alt: 23 substring matches; target not among first 12 visible results.

reference_principles.principle: Building must be a core deliverable, coupled with product ownership. Tool names, PM productivity, prototype mentions, or an isolated PR sentence are insufficient.
Internal tools and functional transformation qualify when the person chooses and directly builds solutions as a product. Customer-specific implementations and account enablement alone do not.

Read qualifications first, but distinguish engineering capability from an engineering career gate. Retain genuine product-building engineering blends separately, while respecting specific negative labels.

Category fit and demanding eligibility are separate dimensions. Alt remains a fit despite high demands; Exiger is an accepted engineering-first blend; SharkNinja has a builder mandate with substantial finance requirements.
